description: This file defines the class 'One2OneBeanRelationship', which manages one-to-one relationships between beans in a CRM system, including methods for adding relationships, updating links, and generating SQL join statements.

classes.name: One2OneBeanRelationship
classes.description: A class representing a one-to-one relationship between beans, extending the 'One2MBeanRelationship' class, with additional logic for managing one-to-one links and SQL joins.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the relationship object using the provided definition.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new bean relationship, removing any existing links on the left side before adding the new one.

methods.name: updateLinks
methods.description: Updates the relationship links between the left and right beans, ensuring only one bean is linked on each side.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Generates the SQL JOIN clause for retrieving related beans, customizable with parameters for table aliases, join type, and deletion filtering.
